name: admission-marks-after-projection-limits
body: Two limits on the admission wiring. (1) An identity deleted and then re-added in the same session keeps its pending-removal ledger entry, because `record_pending_removal` is insert-only and phase 1 has no per-identity ledger clear — the save would then delete the node file the re-add wrote. Upgrade: clear the identity's ledger entry when a later admission of the same identity projects a write. (2) The marks and ledger records run after the projection, as the task orders, so a mark or ledger failure returns `Err` with the projection already landed (also cached by the at-most-once client id); upgrade when admission gains a transactional wrapper, or accept phase-4's pending-state discard-and-rebuild as the repair for a half-applied admission.
